h: Rising From Faith to Truth at the Third Meal

p: is called the meal of Ze'ir Anpin,
and that of the morning the meal of Atika.
it says in the Tikkunei Zohar
corresponding to the holiness of the three Avos,
corresponds to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the third meal to Yaakov;
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 163b)
"Yaakov is the glory of the Avos";
and so it says in the Midrash
And so indeed it is written
that the holiness of this meal
is higher than all the meals,
as he composed in the zemer:
in which is the Will of Wills."
the morning meal of Shabbos called
and the third meal that of Ze'ir Anpin,
when the aspect of the holiness of Atika
than the aspect of the holiness of Ze'ir Anpin?
בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם (בְּרֵאשִׁית טו, ו)
of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him (Bereishis 15:6):
and He reckoned it to him as righteousness";
"and He reckoned it to him as merit."
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, asked:
and why should he not believe
when he himself is the prophet, etc.?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (בְּרָכוֹת ז, ב)
And this is the matter of
what is said in the Pesikta
When He revealed Himself to Yaakov,
He did not reveal Himself to him with Anochi
and said, I am Hashem,' etc.
He said: With my fathers, etc.,
could it be that some sin has befallen me,
that He did not converse with me
with which He conversed with my fathers, etc."
in the midst of the Children of Yisrael";
in which the letter kaf alludes
שֶׁדִּיבֵּר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עִם אַבְרָהָם
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu spoke with Avraham
through the aspect of the Name Ad-nai.
after he was perfected in all the attributes,
as it is written just before:
וְאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קכט, א)
and it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 129a):
which is the crown of Malchus.
that Hashem Yisbarach spoke with him
which is "Ani" with the letter kaf,
for he attained the Name Havayah
through the aspect of the Name Ad-nai,
which is the aspect of emunah.
אַף שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ הַשָּׂגָה בּוֹ
although he did not have attainment of it
And about this it is made clear:
"And He reckoned it to him as righteousness"
that He reckoned it to him as merit,
that he believed in the aspect of emunah.
And so it is expounded in the Mechilta
תָּשׁוּרִי מֵרֹאשׁ אֲמָנָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ד, ח)
"'Look from the summit of Amanah' (Shir HaShirim 4:8),
in the merit of the faith
as it says, 'And he believed in Hashem,'
Yisrael merited to sing the Song."
And this is why Yaakov was distressed
that He did not converse with him
"Could it be that some sin has befallen me?"
his stature was greater than this,
and this is the letter vav,
that he was distressed over this matter,
He began speaking with him with Anochi:
at night is the meal of Yitzchak,
which is the attribute of fear,
and in the morning the meal of Avraham,
and as is written in the Tikkunim cited:
And it is the meal of Atika,
for Avraham merited the attribute of "old,"
as it is written, "And Avraham was old,"
which is the aspect of Atika.
Only, then one attains the holiness
only through the aspect of emunah;
which corresponds to the holiness of
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
to attain in the aspect of truth,
"to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin,"
לֹא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת אֱמוּנָה לְבַד
not through the aspect of emunah alone.
And in truth the Name Havayah
for the four letters of Havayah
and the crownlet of the yud
(as is written in the holy Zohar several times),
through the crownlet of the yud.
in the holy Zohar cited above
that Yaakov is the glory of the Avos,
for he merited to be a chariot
and this is the aspect of truth.
to behold the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin.
